_note: Piper robot 2 (single arm). Joint limits from the Piper spec sheet (J1 +-150, J2 0..180, J3 -170..0; both arms rest at about J2 -2 deg / J3 +2 deg, just past these limits; the firmware (S-V1.8-3) clamps commands to J2 >= 0 / J3 <= 0, so commanding the rest pose lifts the arm 2 deg (seen 2026-10-06), and SafetyFilter.check_state's 0.05 rad margin accepts the rest pose, J4 +-100, J5 +-70, J6 +-120 deg), gripper stroke 0..0.07 m: VERIFY against your firmware/manual, then set verified=true. Mapping is identity (policy trained in Piper units). CAN name pinned to the adapter serial by real_robot/can_persist.sh; Cameras (2026-10-06): three Orbbec Astra Pro Plus whose color sensors all report serial SN0001, so they are addressed by USB port (/dev/v4l/by-path), not by-id: keep each in the same port. cam_high = high stationary camera (port 5.2, shared by both robots, so only one runner at a time), cam_wrist = camera on top of this arm (port 1.2). This arm is the far one from the operator seat.
